title: 等車等紅燈
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L154 等. Use these sentences exactly; spokenText equals text with punctuation removed. Latest origin/main includes L147 間, so L154 depends on unmerged L148 時, L149 還, L150 燈, L151 關, L152 窗, and L153 車. Do not merge production JSON until L148-L153 are present in latest origin/main. Provisional learned chars are 時, 還, 燈, 關, 窗, 車. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only; do not use Hanyu pinyin. Use 為, not 爲; use 裡, not 裏. Do not add unlearned display characters such as 公, 具, 停, 牌, 排, 司, or 機. Sentence 2 image may imply waiting for a bus, but display text must not contain 公車 because 公 is not learned. Sentence 3 image may use a toy car, but display text must not contain 玩具 because 具 is not learned. Images must not include readable bus/train/car signs, route numbers, station names, license plates, labels, text, zhuyin, English, or watermarks. For red-light scenes, use simple red circular traffic lights only; no written signs or numbers. G03 missingIndexes corrected from handoff [8] to [6] because 等 is the 0-based Han index 6 in L154-S02. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio, processed through assets:audio and AI-aligned before production release.

approvedSentences.scene: A child and mom wait together at a red traffic light before crossing or moving. Show a simple red circular light. No text, signs, labels, numbers, walk symbols with writing, or logos.

A child waits with an adult for a vehicle that has not arrived yet. This can imply waiting for a bus, but do not show readable route signs, station names, numbers, labels, or the unlearned word 公車 in the image.

approvedSentences.scene: A child demonstrates a toy car where the car windows and car lights can open or turn on and close or turn off. Use a toy-like small car, but do not show packaging, brand names, text, numbers, labels, or UI.
A small dog waits by a window for family members to come home. Make the dog, window, and waiting posture clear. No signs, text, numbers, or labels.
A child or adult tries to close a difficult window. The window should look stuck or hard to close. No labels, warning text, numbers, or symbols.
